newsitem.title: ZAIRE: East Zaire town of Bukavu has fallen to rebels.
newsitem.headline: East Zaire town of Bukavu has fallen to rebels.

text.p: The east Zaire city of Bukavu has fallen to Tutsi rebels after heavy fighting, a Reuters photographer said on Friday.
"It is completely in rebel hands now. It fell on October 30," said Reuters photographer Corinne Dufka who was in the town throughout the fighting.
Dufka said the Zairean military and allied militiamen fled the city followed by tens of thousands of people in the hours before the rebels entered the town.
She said the Banyamulenge rebels were well disciplined and had not looted the town. They were well equipped with mortars.
She added that she saw 28 people who had been executed by the Zairean army before the troops fled.
